checks.details: Correct fixture passed; injected fault failed; repaired fixture passed.
Icarus 12 compilation and simulation passed without diagnostics; PASS serial framing: 6378 samples, 397 completed frames.

limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation was not accessed and official correctness is not established.
Original specification does not explicitly state done pulse duration; interpreted as one cycle immediately following a valid stop sample.
Power-up state is unspecified; reception checks begin after synchronous reset.
No synthesis, timing, or board verification performed, as required.

implementation.cycle_contract: Start sample, eight data samples, stop sample; valid stop asserts done immediately after that edge for one cycle. Following edge can accept next start. Invalid stop waits for high before returning to start search.
implementation.reset: Active-high synchronous reset clears done and returns to idle.
implementation.numeric_width: One-bit interface; three-bit data index counts eight samples.
implementation.source_closure: Single TopModule with no child modules or external synthesizable dependencies.
implementation.static_review: No added ports or latency, no initial blocks in DUT, no enum ternary, sequential nonblocking assignments, bounded data index.
